results.content: NEW YORK, July 28, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- The Conference Board Consumer Confidence Index® decreased by 1.4 points to 90.8 (1985=100) in July, down from an upwardly revised 92.2 in June. The Present Situation Index—based on consumers' assessment of current business and labor market conditions—fell by 3.6 points to 114.9, its third consecutive monthly decline. The Expectations Index—based on consumers' short-term outlook for income, business, and labor market conditions—remained unchanged at 74.7.
